RUM_VECTORS_REGENERATE=1 cargo test -p common --lib shared_vectors, then review the diff.
Strings hash as UTF-8. Generated stacks are genuine engine output with only the host renamed;
production stacks are anonymised; handwritten ones follow each engine format.
